description: Harezmî Robotics olarak, NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026'da Ay ve Mars yüzeyinde geride bırakılan tarihi uzay mirasını etkileyici bir dijital hikâyeye dönüştürüyoruz. NASA verilerini ve görsellerini kullanarak bu terk edilmiş ekipmanların insanlığın keşif tarihindeki rolünü interaktif bir deneyimle aktarmayı hedefliyoruz. Yaratıcı anlatım, web arayüz tasarımı, 3D modelleme ve veri görselleştirmeyi harmanlayarak unutulmaz bir dijital miras projesi ortaya koyuyoruz.
summary: Our project is designed to deliver an autonomous and efficient solution for complex operational challenges in field environments. By integrating precision mechanical engineering with smart software infrastructure, the system monitors critical conditions in real time and executes target tasks safely and accurately. This approach significantly minimizes human error, operational delays, and risks in challenging conditions, offering a scalable and sustainable technological foundation for modern applications.
details:
• What it does and how it works: Our project operates as an autonomous system that merges mechanical precision with an intelligent software architecture to address operational challenges. It processes real-time sensor data to make optimal decisions, utilizing mechanical actuators to perform targeted tasks with high accuracy.
  • Benefits and Intended Impact: The system aims to eliminate human-dependent risks, minimize time losses, and manage critical operations securely. Our primary impact is providing a sustainable, secure, and highly efficient technological infrastructure.
  • Tools, Coding Languages, Software, and Hardware Used: CAD software was used for mechanical design, while advanced microcontrollers, gear motors, and sensor arrays were integrated for control and autonomy. On the software side, optimized programming languages were chosen to seamlessly manage hardware integration.
  • Creativity and Factors Considered: Our project stands out with its modular structure and adaptability to harsh field conditions. During the design phase, energy efficiency, mechanical durability, safety protocols, and software response times were meticulously addressed by our team.
dataRefs: NASA Earth Observing System Data and Information System (EOSDIS)
